scope: Participant/team-specific Fortnite competitive qualification outcomes for EU/global events relevant to France
source_of_truth: Official Fortnite Competitive results/standings and explicitly authorized organizer results only.

principles.separate_from_global_lifecycle: A qualifier can be globally complete while a participant outcome remains UNKNOWN until official participant-specific evidence is available.
principles.no_absence_inference: Absence from one result page, one final lobby, one article or one crawl never proves ELIMINATED.
principles.stable_participant_id: A tracked player/team keeps one participant_id; display-name changes become aliases.
principles.team_result_scope: A DUOS/TRIOS/SQUADS result belongs to the exact roster/team identity used by the official result source; do not silently transfer it to a player in a different roster.
principles.official_result_required: QUALIFIED, ELIMINATED, DISQUALIFIED and WITHDRAWN require explicit official evidence or a mathematically complete official standings result whose qualification rule is itself verified.

resolution_rules.QUALIFIED: Requires explicit official qualified list/result, or OFFICIAL_STANDINGS_DERIVED where the final official ranking and verified advancement rule unambiguously place the participant inside the qualifying range.
resolution_rules.ELIMINATED: Requires explicit elimination/non-advancement, or OFFICIAL_STANDINGS_DERIVED where the final official ranking and verified advancement rule unambiguously place the participant outside the qualifying range after the phase is final.
resolution_rules.PENDING: Use while a participant has played/entered a qualifying phase but final official advancement result is not yet determinable.
resolution_rules.UNKNOWN: Default when participant-specific evidence is insufficient.

finale_bridge.on_qualified: If qualification_target resolves to a known future phase/competition with official timing, enable participant-specific FINAL reminders without changing the global final VEVENT UID.
finale_bridge.on_eliminated: Suppress only participant-specific PLAY/REGISTER reminders downstream; preserve global WATCH/ATTEND reminders for the final.
finale_bridge.on_pending: Do not create a final PLAY reminder yet.
finale_bridge.same_result_no_repeat: An identical participant outcome never re-notifies.

notify: QUALIFIED to a tracked important target
ELIMINATED from a tracked important path
official correction that changes qualification state
notification_policy.dedupe_key: participant_id + competition_id + phase_id + state + qualification_target + result_fingerprint
